Trump Calling Welker “crooked” “stupid” and then the ultimate—“darling”—for asking him what evidence he has that elections are rigged? What is “crooked” is the money for the ballroom, what is “stupid” are the tariffs. And what is “darling” is a first class journalist.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

"You're either crooked or you're stupid. Let's call it quits.

The Aerial Lift Bridge is a Minnesota landmark that connects Duluth's port to the rest of the world.

I joined Mayor Reinert and local leaders in Duluth from labor and business to highlight federal funding we worked to secure that will restore this iconic bridge and preserve it for generations to come.

I voted no.

I voted no.

posts.text:
I voted until 5 a.m. today to block Trump's $1.8 billion slush fund.
Your tax dollars should not be going to Jan. 6th rioters who went after officers. 

And why give MORE money to ICE when they’re already bigger than the FBI? The extra 70B could instead fund yrs of health care!
